_comment: Project-scoped Claude Code settings. Commit this file to git so the team shares the same hook set. Per-user overrides go in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored). Claude Code discovers .claude/agents/, .claude/skills/, .claude/commands/ and CLAUDE.md by fixed convention, and the schema this file pins has no keys for them.
_hooks_comment: UserPromptSubmit runs route-hook.py on every prompt and injects its output (hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext) so the route-first step happens deterministically. Both Claude Code and VS Code Copilot (Agent Hooks, Preview) read this .claude/settings.json hooks block. Path: Claude Code sets $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR to the repo root even when the session cwd is a subdirectory, so use it; Copilot falls back to $PWD (its hook cwd is the workspace root). '|| true' keeps it fail-open: a context hook always lets the prompt through. A script that is not there prints one 'cypress: hook script missing' line instead of nothing, and `install.sh --check` runs each context hook once (SPEC-0003, SPEC-0001).

hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.claude/route-hook.py"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then python3 "$f" || true; else echo "cypress: hook script missing: $f; continuing without it. Re-run install.sh to restore it."; fi

f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.claude/status-hook.py"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then python3 "$f" || true; else echo "cypress: hook script missing: $f; continuing without it. Re-run install.sh to restore it."; fi

_bound_hook_comment: PreToolUse runs bound-hook.py before every Bash call and refuses (exit 2) a blocking-prone command — service control, process signalling, package managers, installers, builds, log followers — that carries neither an explicit bound nor a detached launch. It is a guard, wired without '|| true' on purpose; its exit-code contract is in integrations/claude-code/README.md (Hooks).
_status_hook_comment: SessionStart runs status-hook.py once per session and injects `status-register.py --summary` (open / hotfix / deferred counts and the oldest items) so lifecycle debt is in front of the model before it plans. Not per prompt: the register is a frontmatter scan, and a session sees it once. Fail-open like route-hook, with the same missing-script line.
